annotations.title: Brazil official PTAX currency conversion (BCB Olinda)

description: Converts an amount between BRL, USD, EUR and GBP at the official Central Bank of Brazil PTAX rate and returns the converted amount, the BRL equivalent and every PTAX bulletin used. Use it whenever a figure must stand up to Brazilian tax, accounting or audit scrutiny, including import and export invoices, transfer pricing and cross-border contracts. Do not use it for a tradable market or retail spread quote, nor for inflation restatement over time (use br_correct_monetary_value). Read-only and idempotent for a given date; omitting date returns the most recent published bulletin, so a later retry may legitimately pick up a newer rate. It prefers the official 'Fechamento PTAX' closing bulletin and falls back to the latest intraday bulletin, reporting which one it used in bulletinType. Costs 0.005 USDC per call via x402 v2 on Base (eip155:8453) or a B2B X-API-Key; weekends, Brazilian holidays and dates with no published quote come back as ptaxConversion.ok:false with a Portuguese reason instead of an exception, and an unpaid call returns HTTP 402 with a PAYMENT-REQUIRED header.

aiSummary.description: When true (the default), appends aiExecutiveBrief, a one-sentence Portuguese summary. Set false to cut roughly 80 ms of latency.

amount.description: Amount to convert, expressed in the 'from' currency, as a plain number (1000 means 1.000,00).

date.description: Optional reference date as YYYY-MM-DD. Omit it for the latest published bulletin. The lookup scans the 10 days up to this date, so a weekend or holiday resolves to the previous business day; a future date has no quote and fails cleanly.

from.description: Source currency. PTAX is always quoted against BRL, so a non-BRL pair such as USD to EUR is routed through BRL using both bulletins.

to.description: Target currency. Must differ from 'from' for the conversion to be meaningful.

name: br_convert_ptax_fx

aiExecutiveBrief.description: One-sentence Portuguese summary of the result. Omitted when aiSummary is false.

error.description: Stable machine-readable failure code. Common values: 'bad_request' (malformed JSON or missing operation), 'invalid_payment' / 'settlement_failed' (x402 verification or settlement refused, returned with HTTP 402), 'B2B_KEY_INVALID' and 'B2B_QUOTA_EXCEEDED' (B2B X-API-Key path).

message.description: Human-readable explanation of the failure, in Portuguese. Safe to log or surface to a human operator.

processingTimeMs.description: Edge processing time in milliseconds, excluding payment settlement.

ptaxConversion.description: The conversion result. Check its ok field before reading the amounts.

brlEquivalent.description: Intermediate value of the operation in BRL, rounded to 2 decimals.

convertedAmount.description: Result in the target currency, rounded to 2 decimals.

error.description: Portuguese reason, present only when ok is false (no published quote, or BCB Olinda HTTP failure).

inputAmount.description: Amount received in the source currency.

ok.description: true when every required PTAX bulletin was found; false when BCB had no quote for the window.

additionalProperties.description: Official PTAX bulletin actually applied for one currency leg.

bulletinType.description: BCB bulletin the quote came from. 'Fechamento PTAX' is the official closing bulletin and is preferred; intraday bulletins are used only when no closing bulletin exists yet.

buyRate.description: PTAX buy rate (cotacao de compra) in BRL per unit of the quoted currency.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the quoted currency (USD, EUR or GBP).

sellRate.description: PTAX sell rate (cotacao de venda) in BRL per unit; this is the rate used for conversion.

timestamp.description: Bulletin publication timestamp as returned by BCB Olinda (Brasilia local time).

ptaxQuotes.description: Map keyed by currency code holding the exact bulletin used for each non-BRL leg.

success.description: false when the call was rejected before any calculation ran. Absent on success paths that return success:true.

suggestedNextSteps.description: Chaining hints for autonomous agents: sibling paid APIs in the same suite that are commonly called right after this one. Purely advisory, never required.

endpoint.description: Absolute HTTPS endpoint of the suggested follow-up API.

priceUsdc.description: Price of the suggested follow-up call, in USDC.

tool.description: Tool name of the suggested follow-up API.

when.description: Condition under which the follow-up call is worth making.
